prompt: A user without write access to a repo comments @copilot. What happens?
explanation: Per GitHub Docs, only users with write access can trigger Copilot cloud agent. This prevents privilege escalation — unauthorized users cannot use the agent to make changes.

options.text: The comment is never presented to the agent — only users with write access can trigger Copilot cloud agent
Copilot asks the user to request access
The comment is queued for admin review
